main_text.l: CHEIRAGOGIA HELIANA De AVRO PHILOSOPHICO NECDUM cognito.

SCribit Basilius Valentinus, ordinis Benedictini Monachus, qui proavorum memoria, ex superiore Alsatia oriundus, Philosophus in Chymia fuit princeps, in Curru suo Triumphali Antimonii p.242. Ubi de lapide Ignis tractat, qui ex Mercurio Antimonii conficitur, in hanc sententiam: Sed lapis ignis (inquit) non tingit universaliter, sicut Lapis Philosophorum, qui ex Solis essentia paratur: Nequaquam. Etenim tantum ei concessum non est ad efficiendum sua virtute: Verum tingit particulariter, nempe Lunam in Solem, praeter stannum & plumbum: Martem & venerem equidem omittit, nisi

page.notes: The first word of the paragraph is a large initial "S" joined to "Scribit"; read as "Scribit". The line "nisi" is printed at the right and the signature "A 5" sits at the foot of the text block (a gathering mark, not in main text). Line-end hyphens were kept as printed. Text at the left edge belongs to the adjacent page and was omitted.
